meta.title: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials FAQ | JEE coaching questions
meta.description: Answers about our JEE coaching: the Kota affiliation, who can join, class timings, batch size, tests, doubts and how to visit a centre.

intro: If your question is not here, call us on {{fact:contact.phone}}.

questions.q: Are you connected to a Kota institute?

a.text: Yes. We are affiliated with a top coaching institute in Kota, which powers our JEE programme.

questions.q: Who can join the two-year programme?

a.text: Anyone who has passed Class 10 from SSC, CBSE or ICSE.
In June, with a foundation period from April.

questions.q: Do you take students in a drop year?

a.text: No. Our programmes are for students in Class 11 and Class 12.

questions.q: What happens if my child misses a class?

a.text: Lectures are also online, so the class can be watched later.
To the doubts forum, a doubt session, or a one-on-one mentoring slot.
After every chapter, every fourth week, once a week, and a full JEE Main mock every month.

questions.q: Are tests on paper or on a computer?

a.text: On a computer, on our online portal, which works like the real JEE.
